chapters.chapterTitle: 第一章 · 午夜的营业时间

segments.sourceText: 巷子尽头的邮局只在月亮升起后营业。白天，那是一间门窗紧闭的旧屋，门口的花盆里种着一棵始终不开花的栀子。
segments.targetText: The post office at the end of the alley opened only after the moon had risen. By day, it was an old house with its doors and windows shut. In a flowerpot by the entrance grew a gardenia that never bloomed.

segments.sourceText: 周宁搬来第三天，才发现门上的营业时间没有写数字，而是一小片银色的月牙。
segments.targetText: It was not until her third day in the neighborhood that Zhou Ning noticed the opening hours on the door. Instead of numbers, there was a small silver crescent moon.

segments.sourceText: 那晚她加班回来，看见屋里透出暖黄的光。一个戴圆框眼镜的老人坐在柜台后面，正在给一叠信封盖章。每盖一下，屋顶就落下一声很轻的响，像有人拨动了风铃。
segments.targetText: That night, she came home late from work and saw warm yellow light spilling out of the house. An elderly man with round glasses sat behind the counter, stamping a stack of envelopes. With each stamp, a faint sound drifted down from the roof, as though someone had touched a wind chime.

segments.sourceText: “这里能寄信吗？”她站在门口问。
segments.targetText: "Can I send a letter here?" she asked from the doorway.

segments.sourceText: 老人抬起头：“当然。只要你知道想寄给谁。”
segments.targetText: The old man looked up. "Of course. As long as you know whom you want to send it to."
"Even if I do not know the address?"

segments.sourceText: “有些人的地址，不在地图上。”他从抽屉里取出一张信纸，推到柜台边缘，“坐下来慢慢写。”
segments.targetText: "Some people have addresses you will not find on a map." He took a sheet of writing paper from a drawer and slid it to the edge of the counter. "Sit down. Take your time."

segments.sourceText: 周宁在窗边坐下。她原本没有要写信的打算，可笔尖碰到纸面的瞬间，一个许久没喊出口的称呼，忽然清清楚楚地浮了上来。
segments.targetText: Zhou Ning sat by the window. She had not meant to write a letter, but the instant her pen touched the paper, a name she had not spoken aloud for a long time came clearly to mind.

segments.sourceText: 窗外，栀子花开了第一朵。
segments.targetText: Outside the window, the gardenia opened its first flower.
